threads.body: Just use `Context.current()`. `Java8BytecodeBridge.currentContext()` is only intended for use inside advice. With inline advice advice code is copied into instrumented method. This means that the advice bytecode must be compatible with the target class. `Context.current()` happens to be an interface static method, invoking it is not legal in pre java8 bytecode. That is why we have `Java8BytecodeBridge.currentContext()`, which is a class static method, that can be invoked from any class.
